title: Planning puts doc2query expansions.csv in the touches of research and refresh items that may reword facts
goal: When /kb-sprint plan or /kb-backlog files or schedules a research or refresh item whose touches name a kb root's articles, its touches include that root's _retrieval/doc2query/expansions.csv, so a reworded fact's stale expansion rows can be pruned in the item. Answers the SP-caqrexqw close: ST-5vtfd3y4 reworded a fact, left three expansion rows stale, and stopped until the orchestrator widened its touches and pruned them by hand.
notes: Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 11 of 13, "Planning rules 1: checks that run behaviour, touches that hold every reader"); the triage reviewer found it serves the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test F2: a content sprint from the research queue lands on headless Sonnet workers.
